concern_summary: This concern focuses on the usage of Onyx Entry to handle financial transactions, including invoice processing and expense tracking, ensuring accurate data manipulation for financial reporting and notifications.
The concern revolves around utilizing the Onyx Policy to determine and update parameters for money requests based on transaction details and associated reports.

This concern encompasses the retrieval and transformation of values using the Onyx Key, enabling the export of the onyx state by ensuring that the correct values are fetched from the context and prepared for further use.
These functionalities are designed to manage user interactions with menus that handle hold requests for transactions, providing users with contextual actions based on the request type.

This concern involves managing and updating the Onyx Payroll Code for specific policy categories, incorporating mechanisms for handling optimistic updates along with success and failure responses. This is crucial for ensuring accurate payroll processing within the Onyx system.
Managing various Onyx operations including deletion of transactions and updating IOU report actions based on provided transaction IDs and report actions.

This concern focuses on constructing and managing Onyx Updates that reflect changes in user account data, including payment methods and enabling/disabling policy categories, ensuring the application state reflects the current user context.
This concern deals specifically with the management of the Onyx updates queue, ensuring that updates are appropriately flushed for processing when the update queue is active.
The concern encompasses the management of tab navigation and focus control within the Onyx application, ensuring seamless user experience as users switch between different tabs.
This concern focuses on the export menu options provided to users, allowing them to initiate different types of export operations related to account details and company cards.
